How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ACTREC Emergency Medicine Physician Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ACTREC Emergency Medicine Physician recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send your application email for the Emergency Medicine Physician post is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Emergency Medicine Physician role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MD/DNB in Emergency Medicine and hold a valid registration with the Medical Council of India (MCI) or Maharashtra Medical Council (MMC).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Emergency Medicine Physician position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Emergency Medicine Physician post at ACTREC as per the released advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Emergency Medicine Physician position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Emergency Medicine Physician post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Emergency Medicine Physician role will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 1,32,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application process for the ACTREC Emergency Medicine Physician recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process involves either appearing for a Walk-in Interview or requesting a Zoom Interview via email with all required documents attached.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date for the Emergency Medicine Physician position?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Emergency Medicine Physician post is scheduled to be held on 1st October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their bio-data, recent passport size photograph, Xerox copies of Aadhar Card, Pan Card, Educational qualification certificates, and Working experience certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for the Emergency Medicine Physician recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Emergency Medicine Physician position is offered on a contract basis (Ad-hoc).
